Three people. One office.
Then a system.

It started in 2020 with a simple refusal: design, web, and marketing should not live in separate vendors. The studio is larger now. The idea is not.

  1. 2020

  3. 2024

  4. 2026

avocadots doesn’t sell tasks. We engineer outcomes where brand, web, and media turn into one unified system.

FAQs

Frequently
asked questions.

What people usually want to know before they sit down with the team.

Explore all FAQs ↗
Are you a Wix-only studio?

No. Wix Studio is a core platform because it is fast to ship and easy for clients to run. We also build Shopify stores and will say when a platform is the wrong fit.

Do you only work in Cyprus?

The studio is in Nicosia. Clients sit across Cyprus and Europe. Remote kickoffs are normal; on-site is available when it helps.

Can we visit the studio?

Yes. The room is in Nicosia. Say so on the first call and Olga will put a time on the calendar.

Do you stay on after launch?

Yes. Monthly care, updates, and a named person on the thread. Christina and Olga do not vanish when the site goes live.

Who will I actually work with?

A named lead from day one. Andreas takes strategy calls. Design, PM, and build stay in-house — the team on this page is the team on the project.

Can you rebuild an existing site?

Yes. Most of the 150+ launches started as sites that looked fine and did not perform. We keep what converts and replace what does not.
